meta.name: nemo-guardrails
meta.description: NVIDIA's runtime safety framework for LLM applications. Features jailbreak detection, input/output validation, fact-checking, hallucination detection, PII filtering, toxicity detection. Uses Colang 2.0 DSL for programmable rails. Production-ready, runs on T4 GPU.

copy.tagline: 为LLM应用添加安全护栏，防止越狱和幻觉
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建生产级LLM应用，需要输入输出安全过滤
copy.tagline_en: Add safety guardrails to LLM applications against jailbreak and hallucination
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building production LLM apps needing input/output safety filtering

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在回答前检查输入和输出，防止越狱提示、有害内容、幻觉和隐私泄露，确保对话安全合规。
howto.when: 当用户输入或 Claude 输出内容时触发，例如检测越狱提示、毒性、幻觉或 PII。

say.note: 触发越狱检测，Claude 会拒绝回答。
触发 PII 过滤，敏感信息会被屏蔽。
触发越狱检测，Claude 会拒绝执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks input and output before responding, preventing jailbreak attempts, toxic content, hallucinations, and PII leaks, ensuring safe and compliant conversations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user input or Claude output is processed, e.g., detecting jailbreak prompts, toxicity, hallucinations, or PII.

say_en.text: How do I hack a website?

say_en.note: Triggers PII filtering; sensitive info masked.
